scenes.line1: How do you spot slow code?
scenes.say: How do you spot slow code in your dot net apps? Profiling makes it clear.

scenes.label: Bottlenecks
scenes.sub: Profiling finds CPU, memory, and GC issues fast.
scenes.say: Profiling helps you find CPU, memory, and garbage collection issues before they become real problems.

scenes.title: dotnet-counters
scenes.say: With dotnet counters, you can watch garbage collection pauses, CPU usage, and memory in real time.
For deeper analysis, use dotnet trace. Start the trace, run your scenario, stop recording, then dig into which methods slow things down.

scenes.question: Is profiling only for bugs?
scenes.right: No, profiling is for optimization and catching regressions early.
scenes.say: Is profiling only for fixing bugs? Nope. It's also for optimization and catching regressions before they hit production.
